# Speedy Gonzalez Roofing

> Licensed, Latino-owned roofing contractor in Hot Springs, Arkansas, with 20+ years on Arkansas roofs and 500+ projects completed. Roof replacement; shingle, metal, and TPO flat roofing; commercial roofing; roof repair and leak repair; hail and storm damage work with insurance claim support; plus gutters, siding, and construction and remodeling. Serving Hot Springs, Garland County, and surrounding counties. Free inspections and written estimates. Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Call 501-359-5550.

- Free roof inspections and written estimates
- Payment: Speedy Gonzalez Roofing does not offer financing or payment plans of any kind. Many roof replacements follow a covered storm or hail claim, and the company inspects free, photographs the damage, and can meet the insurance adjuster on the roof. Coverage is decided by the homeowner's policy and insurer, the deductible applies, and roofs replaced for age, wear, or other non-covered conditions are paid by the customer. See /insurance-claims.

## Roofing Services

- [All Services](https://www.speedygonzalezroofing.com/services): Shingle, metal, and flat roofing plus repairs, storm damage, gutters, and siding across Hot Springs and Garland County
- [Roof Replacement](https://www.speedygonzalezroofing.com/services/roof-replacement): Full tear-off down to the wood, decking check, and a new shingle or metal roof. Most shingle roofs take one to two days; metal takes two to five.
- [Shingle Roofing](https://www.speedygonzalezroofing.com/services/shingle-roofing): Asphalt shingle roof installation and replacement. A new shingle roof lasts 15 to 25 years in Arkansas weather and fits almost every roof shape.
- [Metal Roofing](https://www.speedygonzalezroofing.com/services/metal-roofing): Standing seam and exposed fastener metal roofs. The company puts a metal roof's service life at 40 to 70 years, with greater hail resistance than conventional asphalt shingles.
- [TPO & Flat Roofing](https://www.speedygonzalezroofing.com/services/tpo-flat-roofing): TPO flat roofs for homes, shops, and commercial buildings — a single-ply membrane with heat-welded seams forming one continuous waterproof surface, with a service life the company puts at 20 to 30 years.
- [Commercial Roofing](https://www.speedygonzalezroofing.com/services/commercial-roofing): TPO, flat, and metal roofs plus leak repair for shops, offices, and small commercial buildings, scheduled around business hours where possible.
- [Roof Repair](https://www.speedygonzalezroofing.com/services/roof-repair): Repairs from a few missing shingles through storm damage. The inspection is free, and the company says honestly whether a repair will hold or the roof needs replacing.
- [Roof Leak Repair](https://www.speedygonzalezroofing.com/services/roof-leak-repair): Water rarely enters where the ceiling stain shows, so the leak is traced to its real source and that is fixed rather than patching the symptom.
- [Hail Damage Repair](https://www.speedygonzalezroofing.com/services/hail-damage-repair): Hail damage often hides from the ground. Crews get on the roof, photograph every bruise, and help file the claim.
- [Storm Damage Repair](https://www.speedygonzalezroofing.com/services/storm-damage-repair): After a storm the crew tarps the roof, documents the damage with photos, and meets the insurance adjuster on site.
- [Gutters](https://www.speedygonzalezroofing.com/services/gutters): Seamless gutter installation and repair — moving water off the roof and away from the foundation, which prevents the two most expensive problems a house can have.
- [Siding](https://www.speedygonzalezroofing.com/services/siding): Siding installation and replacement that seals a home against Arkansas rain and heat and cuts energy bills.
- [Construction & Remodeling](https://www.speedygonzalezroofing.com/services/construction-remodeling): Kitchen and bathroom remodeling, drywall, flooring, interior and exterior painting, structural repairs, and new buildings, under Speedy Gonzalez Construction, Inc. — the same company and shop.

## Insurance Claims

- [Insurance Claims](https://www.speedygonzalezroofing.com/insurance-claims): Whether insurance will pay for a roof in Arkansas — free storm inspection, photo documentation, and adjuster meetings. Storm and hail damage is commonly covered; an old or worn-out roof is not. The deductible applies and the adjuster makes the final call.

- [Service Areas Overview](https://www.speedygonzalezroofing.com/service-areas): Every town covered across Garland, Saline, Hot Spring, Clark, Montgomery, and Jefferson counties

- [Arkadelphia, AR](https://www.speedygonzalezroofing.com/service-areas/arkadelphia): Roof repair, replacement, and storm damage help for Clark County homes and rental properties
- [Amity, AR](https://www.speedygonzalezroofing.com/service-areas/amity): Roof repair, replacement, and storm damage work across rural Clark County — the crew drives out
- [Glenwood, AR](https://www.speedygonzalezroofing.com/service-areas/glenwood): Metal roofs, repairs, and storm damage help near the Caddo River and Lake Greeson
- [Mount Ida, AR](https://www.speedygonzalezroofing.com/service-areas/mount-ida): Metal roofs, repairs, and storm damage help near Lake Ouachita, including rural Montgomery County
- [Pine Bluff, AR](https://www.speedygonzalezroofing.com/service-areas/pine-bluff): Roof and hail inspections, storm claims, and replacements for Jefferson County homes

Also served, without a dedicated page: Lake Hamilton, Bismarck, Piney, Jessieville, Royal, Fountain Lake, Red Oak, Oak Grove, and Diamondhead.
